mentions.name: Urbanism Now jobs board
mentions.description: A jobs board for urbanists, spun out of the Urbanism Now newsletter whose jobs links are among its most popular content; it will list urbanism job postings in a dedicated place rather than cramming them into each weekly newsletter issue.
mentions.problem: The newsletter receives more urbanism jobs each week than can be included in an issue, so a separate jobs board is needed to list them.
mentions.source_excerpt: A jobs board for urbanists. I run the newsletter https://urbanismnow.com and our jobs links are some of the most popular and we also get more jobs than we can put each week in the newsletter. So thought I'd spin it out into something a little separate.

evidence.value: A jobs board for urbanists. I run the newsletter https://urbanismnow.com and our jobs links are some of the most popular and we also get more jobs than we can put each week in the newsletter. So thought I'd spin it out into something a little separate.
